metadata.name: Take a screenshot of a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Take a screenshot of a web page” in Recued. Picture an open page as Chrome shows it: the visible part, an element by ref or selector, or screen 1, 2, 3 of a long page from its top. The tab comes forward for a moment, then yours returns. Needs Allow screenshots in the Bridge's side panel. AI apps over MCP receive the picture; Recued's chat does not yet.

ref.help: The ref of one element to picture, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when passing a selector.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

screen.help: One screen of a long page to picture, counted from 1 at its top: 2 is the next screen down, as Page Down shows it. The answer says which screen it pictured of how many. With an element, its screens. 0 pictures the page as it is shown.
screen.label: Screen

selector.help: A CSS selector for one part to picture, such as #chart. Leave it empty to picture the visible page, or to name the part by ref.
selector.label: Part of the page
